verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. Hierarchy and reading order are wrong: 'FREYA ANOUK' sits far above the headline, while 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' is stranded near the bottom, so the byline reads backwards. The yellow frame blocks are pasted over the hero photo. The second photo has shrunk to an unreadable sliver, and huge dead white gaps separate the scattered pieces. The original's full-bleed photo and yellow-block identity are lost. B has a slightly more balanced top margin; A's photo is jammed near the top, which leaves even more lopsided emptiness. Otherwise they are equivalent.
